from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentDocument(BaseModel):
    """A single judgment document extracted from a source file."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of the judgment document")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The cause of action (案由) stated in the document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    judgments: list[JudgmentDocument]
